spots.name: Church of the Intercession on the Nerl

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Intercession on the Nerl is a Russian Orthodox church and a symbol of medieval Russia. It is a monument of the Vladimir-Suzdal school of architecture. It is one of the oldest and best-preserved examples of a single-domed church building in Russia, a type that was widespread in Russian architecture.

spots.name: Dormition Cathedral
spots.summary: The Dormition Cathedral, also known as the Assumption Cathedral, is a Russian Orthodox church in Vladimir, Russia. It is regarded as the mother church of Russia through the 13th century. It is part of a World Heritage Site, the White Monuments of Vladimir and Suzdal.

spots.name: Cathedral of Saint Demetrius

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of Saint Demetrius is a cathedral in the ancient Russian city of Vladimir. It was finished in 1197 during the reign of the Grand Prince Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir-Suzdal to the honour of Saint Demetrius of Thessaloniki.

spots.name: Golden Gate
spots.summary: The Golden Gate of Vladimir, constructed between 1158 and 1164, is the only preserved ancient Russian city gate. A museum inside focuses on the history of the Mongol invasion of Russia in the 13th century.

spots.summary: Vyazniki is a town and the administrative center of Vyaznikovsky District in Vladimir Oblast, Russia. Population: 36,203 (2021 census); 41,248 (2010 census); 40,398 (2002 census); 45,438 (1989 Soviet census).

spots.summary: Bogolyubovo is a rural locality in Suzdalsky District of Vladimir Oblast, Russia, located some 10 kilometers (6.2 mi) northeast of Vladimir, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 4,729 (2021 census); 4,494 (2010 census); 4,218 (2002 census); 4,143 (1989 Soviet census); 3,900 (1969).
